parsed.strategy: Bet on the names where sell-side target flow is most one-sidedly positive over the last 90 days: ARGX, MRK, ABBV, AMGN, LLY in biotech (net_raises 13-26 across 13-22 firms), the security/data software complex (OKTA 63, SNOW 47, CRWD 44, PANW 34 net raises) and the AI semis/power chain (NVDA, TSM, ASML, GEV). I deliberately ignore target-level upside, which the evidence measures as perverse. I would be wrong if the flow is stale: a single bad print (Oct 14 ASML, Oct 15 TSM, Oct 22 ARGX) or a hyperscaler capex pause compresses the whole book at once.
